newsitem.title: USA: CPT sues Steel of West Va..
newsitem.headline: CPT sues Steel of West Va..

text.p: CPT Holdings Inc and Mentmore Holdings Corp said on Wednesday that they have filed a lawsuit to revoke Steel of West Virginia's shareholder rights plan, which is a defense against hostile takeovers.
CPT and Mentmore are supporting a shareholder vote to have the board of directors negotiate the sale of the company.
Steel of West Virginia rejected CPT's $9 a share bid to acquire the company.

CPT said in a statement, "Our primary objective is to negotiate with SWVA's management and board of directors a fair price for the company. If there is more than $9.00 per share of value in the company, we are willing to pay for it."
